# Dorian Award for Outstanding Featured Performance in an Off-Broadway Production

}}
The Dorian Award for Outstanding Featured Performance in an Off-Broadway Production is a theatrical award given annually to the best featured performance in a musical or play Off-Broadway by GALECA: The Society of LGBTQ Entertainment Critics since 2010 (the group was initially named the Gay and Lesbian Entertainment Critics Association). The category was preceded by 'Outstanding Off-Broadway Performance,' introduced in 2023, before splitting into lead and featured categories.
